answer:
I fixed two commits since `v2.0.0` that broke the tests. The full `npm test` run is now green: 517 passed, 0 failed (8 were failing before).

1. **`958d3ae` (thousands separators in `formatMoney`)**: this commit changed how the cents are padded from the left to the right. So 1 cent showed as "$0.10" instead of "$0.01". The PIN-03 price ($1.05 showing as $1.50) was the same bug. Fix in `src/money.js`: pad the cents on the left again (`padEnd` back to `padStart`). The comma separators still work.
2. **`4188e9a` (per-line discount groundwork)**: tax was computed on the subtotal before the order-level code came off, so SPRING10 in CA-ON was taxed on the full amount. Fix in `src/invoice.js`: `taxable = subtotal - discount`, which is how it worked at `v2.0.0`.

Only those two lines changed. No tests were touched. Everything else these commits added still works: line discounts, the `lineDiscounts`/`taxable` fields, the empty-invoice check, the render line and the docs. Changes are uncommitted.
